gramlot-py-server 0.2.6 follows the core 0.2.14: every call of a page is an envelope at `POST /gramlot/rpc`, answered by `GramlotServer.call`. It requires `gramlot>=0.2.14`.

## Core 0.2.14

- The five adapters route `POST /gramlot/rpc` to `GramlotServer.call(text, owner=…)`. The body is passed as text, never pre-parsed; Kajenn passes its raw body. The answer is 200 `application/json` with the response envelope `{id, contentType, value}` or `{id, contentType, error}`; 400 `Invalid envelope` when `call` raises `InvalidRequest`.
- `POST /gramlot/main` and `POST /gramlot/source` are removed. `POST /gramlot/close` with `{pageId}` is unchanged.
- The bootstrap config is `{pageId, rpcUrl, closeUrl, rootId, capabilities}`; `capabilities` is `[]` in every adapter. An endpoint with an `auth` rule answers `not_authenticated`.
- A call of an unknown, expired or unowned page is the outcome `page_expired` (was 404 `Unknown page`); an undeclared fragment or endpoint is `not_found` (was 404 `Unknown Source method`); an exception of the page method is `application_error` (was 500). All are 200 responses.
- The 4096-byte request limit and its 413 are removed: the contract fixes no size. A web server in front, Flask `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` or Django `DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE` may still refuse a body.
- A body that is not UTF-8 answers 400 `Request body is not UTF-8` in the five adapters.
- The Kajenn adapter behaves as the others. Mapping endpoints to genro-routes entries with the `AuthPlugin` is a later step.

## Tests

- The conformance page declares `check_fragment` and the endpoints `check_endpoint`, `check_endpoint_auth` (`auth="admin"`) and `check_endpoint_raise` of the core fixture; `check_protocol` of the core 0.2.14 passes on the five adapters, at the site root and under `/py` with the strict policy: 10 cases.
- The adapter, project and tutorial tests send envelopes through `tests/rpc_checks.py`.
- Against the published core 0.2.14: 85 tests pass with every extra. The browser checks pass in Chromium for the five adapters under `/py` and for the gallery of every environment.

## Documentation

- The guides and their paired views describe `/gramlot/rpc`, the envelope, the outcomes and the new 400 answers, and no longer the size limit.
- The README compatibility table names the core 0.2.14 and `gramlot-examples` 0.2.9.

## Other changes

- The core requirement is `gramlot>=0.2.14`, in the package, in the CI jobs and in the contributor notes.
